answer: Participants failing to answer or caught duplicating identities forfeit the bond, making fake accounts a hollow investment with real losses. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and every epoch it must submit a verifiable pulse of work signed with its key. The registry keeps a public ledge of bonded keys and reputation history, so peers can audit who actually earned standing and who merely minted aliases to farm rewards. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
